001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.memory.IStateBool;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012
013/**
014 * if z in cond then x = y else x = {}
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class PropContainsImpliesEqual extends Propagator<SetVar> {
019
020    private final SetVar cond, x, y;
021    private final ISetDeltaMonitor xD, yD;
022    private final int z;
023    private final IStateBool condDecided;
024
025    public PropContainsImpliesEqual(SetVar cond, int z, SetVar x, SetVar y) {
026        super(new SetVar[]{cond, x, y}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, true);
027        this.cond = cond;
028        this.x = x;
029        this.xD = x.monitorDelta(this);
030        this.y = y;
031        this.yD = y.monitorDelta(this);
032        this.z = z;
033        this.condDecided = cond.getEnvironment().makeBool(false);
034    }
035
036    private boolean isCondVar(int vIdx) {
037        return vIdx == 0;
038    }
039
040    private boolean isXVar(int vIdx) {
041        return vIdx == 1;
042    }
043
044    private boolean isYVar(int vIdx) {
045        return vIdx == 2;
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
050        PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(x, y, this);
051        if (cond.getLB().contains(z) || x.getLB().size() > 0) {
052            cond.force(z, this);
053            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(x, y, this);
054            PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(y, x, this);
055            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(y, x, this);
056            condDecided.set(true);
057        } else if (!cond.getUB().contains(z) || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(y, x)) {
058            cond.remove(z, this);
059            x.instantiateTo(new int[]{}, this);
060            condDecided.set(true);
061            setPassive();
062        }
063        xD.startMonitoring();
064        yD.startMonitoring();
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
069        if (isCondVar(idxVarInProp) || (x.getLB().size() > 0 && cond.force(z, this))) {
070            if (!condDecided.get()) {
071                if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
072                    PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(x, y, this);
073                    PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(y, x, this);
074                    PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(y, x, this);
075                    condDecided.set(true);
076                } else if (!cond.getUB().contains(z)) {
077                    x.instantiateTo(new int[]{}, this);
078                    condDecided.set(true);
079                    setPassive();
080                }
081            }
082        } else if (isXVar(idxVarInProp)) {
083            if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
084                xD.forEach(xKer -> y.force(xKer, this), SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
085                xD.forEach(xEnv -> y.remove(xEnv, this), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
086            } else {
087                xD.forEach(xEnv -> {
088                    if (y.getLB().contains(xEnv)) {
089                        cond.remove(z, this);
090                        x.instantiateTo(new int[]{}, this);
091                        condDecided.set(true);
092                    }
093                }, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
094                if (condDecided.get()) {
095                    setPassive();
096                }
097            }
098        } else {
099            if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
100                yD.forEach(yKer -> x.force(yKer, this), SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
101            } else {
102                yD.forEach(yKer -> {
103                    if (!x.getUB().contains(yKer)) {
104                        cond.remove(z, this);
105                        x.instantiateTo(new int[]{}, this);
106                        condDecided.set(true);
107                    }
108                }, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
109                if (condDecided.get()) {
110                    setPassive();
111                }
112            }
113            yD.forEach(yEnv -> x.remove(yEnv, this), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
114        }
115    }
116
117    @Override
118    public ESat isEntailed() {
119        if (cond.getLB().contains(z) || x.getLB().size() > 0) {
120            if (!cond.getUB().contains(z) || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(x, y) || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(y, x)) {
121                return ESat.FALSE;
122            }
123            if (cond.getLB().contains(z) && x.isInstantiated() && y.isInstantiated()) {
124                assert (Arrays.equals(x.getLB().toArray(), y.getLB().toArray()));
125            }
126            return cond.getLB().contains(z) && x.isInstantiated() && y.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
127        } else if (!cond.getUB().contains(z)) {
128            if (x.getLB().size() > 0) {
129                return ESat.FALSE;
130            }
131            return x.getUB().isEmpty() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
132        }
133        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
134    }
135
136    @Override
137    public String toString() {
138        return "if " + z + " in " + cond + " { " + x + " = " + y + " } else { " + x + " = {}}";
139    }
140}
